purpose: Inclusion rule for planted-signal joins in the manuscript figures and main table, fixed before the runs on the rel-stack posts and comments joins and before the third seed.

criteria.learnability: the best aggregator (any layers, d = 128) reaches test AUROC >= 0.90 on the parent_query label among test seeds with K <= 4 admissible children

applies_to: every planted join, including those run before this rule was written (rel-f1 results, rel-stack badges, rel-avito SearchInfo, rel-avito VisitStream); excluded joins are still reported in the repository tables
